evidence_basis.strongest_training_interpretation: Teach content-dependent episode-local semantic-class to symbol routing and context-invariant variable binding while protecting already-present semantic readout, symbol writeout and carrier algebra.
evidence_basis.no_credit_boundary: This file is source/design evidence only. It creates zero model-runtime, J-Space causal, training, HCU or whole-product credit.

preregistered_resolution.class_word_policy: ALLOW/DENY/ABSTAIN may appear only inside the episode-local codebook span. They are forbidden in all other model-visible situation, query, rationale and target text. Metadata not shown to the model may contain canonical class IDs.
preregistered_resolution.reason: This resolves the supplied source tension without silently mixing incompatible leakage rules.
preregistered_resolution.symbol_policy: Every materialized row must draw three distinct symbols from the 46 accepted ABI atoms. Placeholder ATOM_A/B/C in this design must be replaced by exact atom-row identities before row admission.
preregistered_resolution.target_policy: The visible target is the single mapped symbol only; canonical class IDs remain hidden metadata for validation.

round_1.candidate: Scale the existing generator directly to a large remapping corpus.
rejections: ADVERSARIAL_SHORTCUT_HUNTER: permutation metadata can vary while the realized codebook mapping remains unchanged; this would teach a shortcut instead of causal remapping.
STATISTICAL_REVIEWER: len(perms)>=3 is insufficient; complete S3 coverage and realized mapping checks are required.
ABI_PROVENANCE_REVIEWER: row/atom identity and manifest-member integrity are not fully validated.
RETENTION_REVIEWER: large-scale training before a small audited seed risks damaging already-present read/write functions.

round_2.candidate: Use a minimal fully crossed causal seed matrix with placeholders resolved only after ABI verification.
repairs: realized mapping is constructed from the selected S3 permutation, never inferred from a logged permutation ID
target symbol is derived from the realized mapping after construction
four training templates are crossed with all six S3 mappings and all three semantic classes
codebook presentation order is independently shuffled from semantic-to-symbol mapping
class labels are confined to the codebook span
lexical families are split-isolated at semantic-bearing token/family level
a fifth template family is frozen and absent from train and validation
unseen-symbol holdout draws from accepted ABI atoms never used in training triplets
retention tests are frozen before any tuning
round_2.review_verdict: ACCEPT_AS_AUDITED_SOURCE-DESIGN SEED CONTRACT; DO_NOT SCALE UNTIL MATERIALIZED ROWS PASS ALL GATES.

seed_matrix_contract.derivation: 4 training templates x 6 realized S3 permutations x 3 semantic classes = 72 rows before lexical-family replication.
seed_matrix_contract.counterbalance_property: Across the complete 72-row matrix, each semantic class maps equally often to each symbol slot and every template observes the full S3 family.
seed_matrix_contract.scale_rule: Only after the exact 72-row seed passes all deterministic validators may lexical-family replication expand the matrix. Expansion must preserve family-level split isolation and counterbalance.

adversarial_pair_requirements: CODEBOOK_FLIP_PAIR: same semantic case and same surface template, change only the realized class-symbol mapping; target must change accordingly.
SEMANTIC_FLIP_PAIR: same codebook and same surface template, change only the semantic case class; target must follow the codebook.
ORDER_SHUFFLE_PAIR: same semantic case and same realized mapping, change only codebook-entry order; target must remain invariant.
LEXICAL_PARAPHRASE_PAIR: same hidden class and realized mapping but disjoint semantic-bearing wording; target must remain invariant.
DISTRACTOR_PAIR: add non-semantic protocol-neutral text that does not alter the case; target must remain invariant.
MISSING_EVIDENCE_PAIR: minimally remove the decisive evidence from a determinate case so that the semantic class becomes unresolved; target must switch through the same codebook.
deterministic_validator_gates: EXACT_S3_REALIZED: each template must realize exactly all six S3 mappings, checked from the actual class-symbol dictionary rather than metadata IDs.
TARGET_DERIVATION: recompute target_symbol from hidden_class and realized mapping; reject any mismatch.
COUNTERBALANCE_EXACT: for every template, each class maps to each symbol slot exactly twice across the 18-row template block.
CLASS_SYMBOL_MI: report empirical class-symbol mutual information over the balanced matrix and require numerical near-zero within deterministic tolerance.
ENTRY_ORDER_INDEPENDENT: realized mapping and display order must be stored separately; display-order changes must not alter target.
CLASS_WORD_LEAK: outside the parsed codebook span, reject ALLOW/DENY/ABSTAIN and registered synonyms/aliases that directly reveal the canonical class label.
LEXICAL_FAMILY_ISOLATION: hash full normalized semantic-bearing lexical-family inventories and enforce train/validation/holdout disjointness with explicit protocol-token exemptions.
FROZEN_TEMPLATE_D: T5 and all of its semantic-bearing lexical families must be absent from train and validation.
UNSEEN_SYMBOL_HOLDOUT: reserve accepted ABI atom rows never used in training triplets; holdout selection is frozen before tuning.
ABI_INTEGRITY: verify archive/manifest member hashes, exact atom-row mapping, rejected atom exclusion, tokenizer single-token property and exact model/tokenizer identity before materialization.
PROVENANCE_BINDING: bind each materialized row to generator version, source package hash, ABI manifest hash, model snapshot, tokenizer identity and causal/provenance family.
NO_HOLDOUT_SELECTION: reject any row family, template, symbol set or hyperparameter selected using frozen holdout results.

protect: carrier binding through k<=16 already observed sufficient at the measured ABI scope
retention_and_causal_evaluation.causal_post_training_test: After a candidate binder exists, lesion or shuffle the learned binding path while preserving semantic readability; symbol choice should fail, and rescue should restore it. Output accuracy alone is insufficient for J-Space causal credit.
retention_and_causal_evaluation.negative_control: Do not treat pre-training absence of the binder as evidence that a specific post-training circuit has been identified.

research_return.new_training_rule: Episodic remapping data should be generated as causal counterfactual families, not independent IID prompt-answer rows.
research_return.new_architecture_implication: The strongest measured bottleneck is routing/binding between already-readable semantics and already-writable symbol axes, so the training/harness interface should expose and test the mapping operation explicitly.
research_return.new_falsifier: If fully counterbalanced, lexically isolated, multi-template remapping training fails to improve unseen-template/unseen-symbol binding while retaining read/write functions, the narrow low-rank-router hypothesis loses support and broader model adaptation becomes more plausible.
research_return.anti_goodhart: A model that memorizes template, symbol frequency, codebook position or lexical family must fail paired counterfactual gates even if aggregate accuracy is high.

next_exact_actions: Materialize the exact 72-row seed only after the 46 accepted ABI atom identities are available at exact hash and the generator constructs realized mappings causally.
Run the deterministic validator suite against the 72-row seed; swarm-review every failure and repair the generator rather than weakening gates.
Freeze T5, unseen-symbol atom rows, lexical families and retention baseline before any pilot tuning.
Scale by lexical-family replication only after the seed passes exact S3, leakage, provenance and counterfactual-pair gates.
Keep accepted_dataset_tokens, model-runtime, J-Space causal, training, HCU and whole-product credit at zero until their separate executable evidence exists.
